title: Regulation of taurine transporter gene (TauT) by WT1

sections.abstract: <jats:p>In the present study we have demonstrated that WT1 (Wilms tumor suppressor gene) enhances the expression of <jats:italic>TauT</jats:italic> (taurine transporter gene) in human embryonic kidney 293 cells in a dose‐dependent manner. <jats:italic>TauT</jats:italic> promoter activity was increased five‐fold by cotransfection of a full‐length <jats:italic>TauT</jats:italic> promoter–reporter construct with WT1. Electrophoretic mobility shift assays (EMSAs) using nuclear extracts from WT1‐overexpressing 293 cells showed a putative WT1‐binding site in the basal promoter region of <jats:italic>TauT</jats:italic>, which bound to WT1 in EMSAs. Mutation of this WT1 consensus sequence abolished binding of WT1. These results demonstrate that <jats:italic>TauT</jats:italic> may represent a downstream target gene of WT1 during renal development.</jats:p>
